title: The Unfamiliar Kitchen
objective: Make a peanut butter and jam sandwich and serve it on the plate. Aim for a richer recognizable sandwich combination with suitable extras; plain PB&J is a passing result.
initial_objective: Explore your surroundings and find out what you need to do.
opening_narrative: You wake in an unfamiliar kitchen, not knowing how you arrived or what you are supposed to do. A yellow Post-it note is stuck to the worktop. Nearby stand a cupboard, a bread bin, a fruit bin and a refrigerator.

body.description: A mobile body with hands, able to carry one inventory unit. Visible local food can be prepared in place while a tool is carried.

postit-note.readable_text: Make a peanut butter and jam sandwich and serve it on the plate. Aim for a richer recognizable sandwich combination with suitable extras; plain PB&J is a passing result.

recipe-note.name: Recipe note
recipe-note.description: A handwritten recipe note. Read it to learn the instructions.
recipe-note.readable_text: Sandwich preparation: slice bread with the knife. Use the knife to spread exposed portions and add prepared fillings to either slice, then assemble and serve on the plate. Explore the storage containers for choices. Equipment instructions: plug an appliance into the free outlet and switch it on before using it; switch it off before unplugging it. The maker grinds roasted peanuts into peanut butter. Carry the frying pan to place it on the stove; cook bacon in the pan with the stove powered. Food can be prepared locally while the knife is carried. Nutrition labels describe each whole item or measured portion, not values per 100 g.

recipe_actions.slice: Slice a visible local whole food with a carried intact knife. Equal portions appear on the worktop; the whole food is used up.
recipe_actions.dice: Dice a visible local tomato or tomato slice with a carried intact knife. Its diced portion appears on the worktop.
recipe_actions.spread: Use a carried intact knife to spread a visible measured portion onto a local bread slice. Spreads can be layered; the portion and its nutrition become part of the slice.
recipe_actions.add: Use the carried knife to add a visible prepared filling to a bread slice. Its ingredients and nutrition transfer to the slice.
recipe_actions.grind: Grind visible roasted peanuts into peanut butter using the connected, switched-on maker.
recipe_actions.cook: Cook visible raw bacon in a frying pan placed on the connected, switched-on stove.
recipe_actions.assemble: Assemble prepared bread with peanut butter and a chosen jam into a sandwich on the worktop. Optional fillings stay included. Serve it separately.
